description: Edge case: Empty file becomes non-empty externally
prompt:
1. Read an empty file:
<context-item use="read-file">
{"path": "src/empty.js"}
</context-item>

2. Try to add content:
<action execute="write-file">
{"path": "src/empty.js", "content": "export const ADDED = 'by-llm';"}
</action>

NOTE: The empty file will have content added externally. System should detect the change.
